note: Pre-closing notice periods used by deal_timeline.py. 'days' is from the cited source. Where the source gives no fixed period, 'days' is null and the script applies a conservative placeholder that counsel must replace. Not legal advice.

WA.rule: HB 2548: 60-day notice; AG information requests delay closing to 30 days after substantial compliance

IN.rule: AG notice at least 90 days before closing when a party has at least $10M in total assets; include HSR filing

RI.rule: AG pre-merger notice for medical practice groups and MSOs

ME.rule: LD 2201: 180 days' notice to DHHS for PE, hedge fund and qualifying MSO transactions over $100M in assets, among other triggers

MN.rule: Comprehensive review with a 60-day period above $80M trailing revenue; streamlined notice from $10M to $80M

OR.rule: Health Care Market Oversight: detailed pre-closing application, public materials, conditional approvals up to five years; SB 951 limits MSO control

CA.rule: OHCA material change notice with possible cost and market-impact review; parallel HSR notice to AG from Jan 1, 2027

MA.rule: Material change notice to the Health Policy Commission, now covering PE investments and sale-leasebacks

CT.rule: Material change notice to AG and Office of Health Strategy; review can extend past closing

IL.rule: HB 5000 notice covering transactions above the facility level, including PE, effective Jan 1, 2027

NY.rule: Existing material transaction notice; 2026 proposals would expand review and post-closing reporting

VT.rule: H.583 ownership reporting (due Mar 1, 2027) and limits on interference with clinical decisions
